list: Official 55 trophies, 1 platinum / 2 gold / 6 silver / 46 bronze; 28 hidden until earned (Exophase, cross-checked 18 Nov 2026; corroborated by KeenGamer, OutputLag and eGamers, 20 Nov 2026). Names, descriptions and grades are PlayStation's own words; every guide below is written for this atlas, in our own words, and names its sources.

trophies.guide: What to do: earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own [2][3][5]. Where and how: there is no separate task — work the roadmap in order (story first, then side strands, then the long count-based grinds) and the platinum is the last thing you collect [2]. Missable: no, it cannot be missed; it only waits for the other 54 [2].
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

sources.detail: full trophy guide — story chapter roadmap; confirms this trophy's story beat
sources.name: PowerPyx

trophies.guide: What to do: finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing [2][3][5]. Where and how: play the story from the start; the mission is the game's first story beat and unlocks the trophy when its final objective clears [2]. Missable: no — story missions cannot be skipped past, and there is no way to finish the game without it [2].
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

sources.detail: full trophy guide — story chapter roadmap; confirms this trophy's story beat
sources.name: PowerPyx

trophies.guide: What to do: play through every mission of Chapter 1 until the chapter closes [2][4][6]. Where and how: follow the story markers in order; the trophy pops at the chapter-end screen [3]. Missable: no [2]. Note for the road ahead: Chapter 1 also holds the first meditation spot for Positive Mental Attitude, so meditate there before the chapter ends [2].
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: What to do: finish every mission of Chapter 2 [2][3][5]. Where and how: keep following the story markers after Chapter 1; both protagonists become playable here, which opens most of the open-world list [2]. Missable: no [2].
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: What to do: finish every mission of Chapter 3 [2][3][5]. Where and how: story markers in order; this chapter holds the Cartel Heist mission (Break the Bank) [2]. Missable: no [2].
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: What to do: finish every mission of Chapter 4 [2][3][5]. Where and how: story markers in order; this chapter holds the VCIA Takedown mission (Hi-Jacked) [2]. Missable: no [2].

trophies.guide: What to do: complete the final story mission [2][4][6]. Where and how: finish Chapters 1 to 4 and play the finale to its end; the gold pops when the credits roll [3]. Missable: no [2]. Before you start it, make a manual save: the finale is the point of no return for anything chapter-locked, and a save lets you go back for cleanup [2].
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: What to do: finish the story mission Breakfast Run [2][3][5]. Where and how: it appears as a story marker in the early chapters; play it through to the debrief and the trophy pops [2]. Missable: no — it is a required story mission [2].

trophies.disputeShort: live: finish 100% before the finale; our guide: no cutoff
trophies.guide: What to do: reach 100% completion on the in-game checklist [1][4][6]. Where and how: the checklist covers the story, side strands, activities, collectibles and challenges — in practice, finishing this atlas's other 53 trophies gets you most of the way there, and the game's own 100% screen shows exactly what is left [2]. Do the count trophies (250 stunts, 100 WAiNK spots, 100 vehicles, 50 challenges, all shooting-range golds) before the final push, since they are the usual stragglers [2]. Missable: no, but it is the longest grind in the list — both PowerPyx and GTABase rank it the hardest trophy [1][2].
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: What to do: complete 250 stunts — jumps, near-misses, drifts and air time all count toward the tally [1][4][6]. Where and how: stunts stack up naturally while driving and riding around Leonida; chase the tally deliberately on long highway runs and off-road jumps, switching vehicles to keep the stunt types varied [2]. The game's stunt counter shows your running total, so check it between sessions [2]. Missable: no — stunts can be done at any time after the opening [1].
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

sources.detail: official list — confirms this trophy's name, description and grade

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: What to do: try every type of activity in the game at least once — racing, fishing, shooting range, drone racing, arcade games, bowling, meditation, hunting and the rest [1][4][6]. Where and how: activities unlock as you explore; the in-game activity menu shows which types you have tried and which are still untouched, so work down that list rather than guessing [2]. Missable: no, but check the menu early — one or two activity types only appear in specific places [1].
trophies.name: Master of None

sources.detail: official list — confirms this trophy's name, description and grade

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: What to do: earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges [1][4][6]. Where and how: visit the shooting ranges across Leonida and work through each challenge; gold needs accuracy and speed together, so learn one range's targets first, then repeat the pattern — the same weapon handling carries across all 42 [2]. Replay any challenge freely until gold lands [2]. Missable: no — ranges stay open after the story [1].
trophies.name: The Shootist

sources.detail: official list — confirms this trophy's name, description and grade
sources.name: Exophase

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: What to do: win a Top Fun drone race at every race location [1][4][6]. Where and how: find the Top Fun drone-race spots around Leonida and win at each one; a win only counts at the location where you race it, so the trophy needs a victory everywhere, not several wins in one place [2]. Learn each course's corners on a practice run before racing for the win [2]. Missable: no [1].
trophies.name: Top Fun

sources.detail: official list — confirms this trophy's name, description and grade
sources.name: Exophase

trophies.guide: What to do: win 20 different races [1][4][6]. Where and how: races are scattered across Leonida — street, off-road and water events all count as long as each race is a different one [2]. Winning the same race twice does not add to the count, so keep moving to new start lines and tick them off the race list [2]. Missable: no [1].
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

sources.detail: official list — confirms this trophy's name, description and grade

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: What to do: beat Cal in a fishing challenge [1][4][6]. Where and how: take the fishing challenge against Cal when it is offered and out-fish him — steady reeling beats frantic reeling, and a bigger catch wins the round [2]. The challenge can be retried if you lose [2]. Missable: no [1].
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

sources.detail: official list — confirms this trophy's name, description and grade

trophies.guide: What to do: complete one arcade game [1][4][6]. Where and how: find an arcade cabinet in Leonida, start any game on it and play it to its end — finishing one game is enough, no high score needed [2]. Missable: no [1].

Missable: no — side strands stay available after the story [2].

trophies.guide: What to do: finish Kenton's mission strand, ending with his final mission [2][4][6]. Where and how: Kenton's missions appear as side markers; play them in unlock order and the trophy pops at the end of his last one [3]. Missable: no [2].

Where and how: stranger markers appear all over the map — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret are five of them, so keep taking stranger missions as they appear and the silver pops on the eighth completed strand [2]. The game's stranger menu shows which strands are finished [2]. Missable: no — strands stay available after the story [1].

trophies.dispute: PowerPyx and GTABase count 18 meditation spots; PowerPyx's 100% checklist (15 of 18 meditations) needs only 15 of 18, while the trophy needs all 18. Whether the Chapter 1 meditation counts is unconfirmed (PowerPyx). Not settled — track to 18.
trophies.disputeShort: guides count 18 spots; PowerPyx's 100% checklist (15 of 18 meditations) needs only 15 of 18
trophies.guide: What to do: meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida — 18 spots in 10 locations, for both Jason and Lucia [1][4][6]. Where and how: meditation spots are marked as you find them; sit and complete the meditation at each one, checking the count as you go so none is left half-done [2]. Missable: YES — the only trophy both PowerPyx and GTABase flag as possibly missable [1][2]. The first spot is offered at home in Chapter 1 and becomes unavailable after that chapter ends, so meditate there before finishing Chapter 1, keep a manual save at the start of every chapter, and do not rely on mission replay (there is none) [1].
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: What to do: hunt a unique animal for Bret — which animal exactly triggers the trophy is not yet confirmed [2][3]. Where and how: Bret's hunting quests run through his Target Decks: hunt the animals on his lists and bring them back as Jason [3]. The 100% checklist needs all 15 Target Decks anyway, so the hunt is worth doing either way [3]. Missable: no [2].

trophies.guide: What to do: complete 3 collectible card sets [1][4][6]. Where and how: cards are hidden around Leonida — in shops, side locations and mission areas — and each set needs every card in it, so collect by set rather than at random and use the collection menu to see which cards each set is still missing [2]. Missable: no — cards stay collectible after the story [1].
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

sources.detail: official list — confirms this trophy's name, description and grade

trophies.guide: What to do: use the WAiNK It feature at 100 different locations [1][4][6]. Where and how: open WAiNK It at each new spot you visit — landmarks, viewpoints and named places all count, but the same location twice does not [2]. The counter in the app shows your running total, so sweep region by region and let the count guide the route [2]. Missable: no — locations stay open after the story [1].
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

sources.detail: official list — confirms this trophy's name, description and grade
sources.name: Exophase

trophies.guide: What to do: complete 50 challenges [1][4][6]. Where and how: challenges cover driving, combat, exploration and activities — the challenge menu lists them all with their progress, so work through the easiest ones first and let the harder ones (gold shooting-range medals, long stunt totals) finish in the background [2]. Missable: no [1].
trophies.name: One Last Thing

sources.detail: official list — confirms this trophy's name, description and grade
sources.name: Exophase

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: What to do: with your partner beside you, reach a 4-star wanted level, then lose it and escape [1][4][6]. Where and how: build heat with your partner in the car — committing crimes in a busy area raises stars fast — then break line of sight, get out of the search zone and stay hidden until the stars clear [2]. Doing it with your partner present is the requirement; losing the level alone does not count [2]. Missable: no [1].
trophies.name: Hot Together

sources.detail: official list — confirms this trophy's name, description and grade
sources.name: Exophase

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: What to do: with your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your wanted level [1][4][6]. Where and how: pick three shops close together, hit them one after another with your partner present, and keep the wanted level alive between robberies — do not let the stars clear or the chain breaks [2]. A fast car parked outside each shop keeps the run moving [2]. Missable: no [1].
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

sources.detail: official list — confirms this trophy's name, description and grade
sources.name: Exophase

trophies.guide: What to do: discover 100 different vehicles [1][4][6]. Where and how: every new vehicle you drive or ride adds to the count — cars, bikes, boats and aircraft all count, but the same model twice does not [2]. Variety is the fastest route: try new vehicles whenever you see one instead of sticking to one car [2]. The discovery counter shows your total [2]. Missable: no [1].
trophies.name: Whip It Good

sources.detail: official list — confirms this trophy's name, description and grade
sources.name: Exophase

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: What to do: take down 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus [1][4][6]. Where and how: trigger Combat Focus in a fight with at least five enemies close together, then chain the takedowns before the focus meter runs out — a crowded shootout or a gang hideout is the place to try it [2]. If the focus ends early, the count resets, so pick a fight with enough targets [2]. Missable: no [1].
trophies.name: Gunslinger

sources.detail: official list — confirms this trophy's name, description and grade
sources.name: Exophase

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: What to do: leave Vice City International Airport in an unscheduled way — that is, take off in an aircraft without going through normal departure [2][4][6]. Where and how: get to the airfield at VCIA, get into a plane and take off from the runway or taxiway without waiting for clearance; the trophy pops once you are airborne off-schedule [3]. Missable: no [2].
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: What to do: steal a military tank and fight from inside it until the trophy pops [2]. Where and how: tanks stand at the south end of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the south-west edge of the map [2][3]. Drive in through the gate, climb into a tank and shoot enemies from inside it until the trophy unlocks [2]. Missable: no [2].
trophies.hint: Steal a tank at Mile Zero Air Station
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: What to do: rob a jewelry store without being detected [1][4][6]. Where and how: plan the entry — go in quiet, avoid cameras and staff sightlines, take the goods and leave before any alarm [2]. If you are spotted, leave and try again; detection fails the attempt, not the trophy [2]. Missable: no [1].
trophies.name: Sneakthief

sources.detail: official list — confirms this trophy's name, description and grade
sources.name: Exophase

trophies.guide: What to do: rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one [1][4][6]. Where and how: bank vaults are found in banks across Leonida — crack each vault, grab the take and get clear of the wanted level before the next [2]. Each vault counts only if you escape, so plan the getaway before the robbery, not after [2]. Missable: no [1].
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

sources.detail: official list — confirms this trophy's name, description and grade
sources.name: Exophase

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: What to do: rob an armored truck and escape [1][4][6]. Where and how: armored trucks run set routes around Leonida — stop one, break it open, take the cash and lose the wanted level [2]. The trophy pops once you have escaped, not when you open the truck [2]. Missable: no [1].
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

sources.detail: official list — confirms this trophy's name, description and grade
sources.name: Exophase

trophies.guide: What to do: explore every area of Leonida until the whole map is uncovered [1][4][6]. Where and how: drive, ride and fly through each region — the map fills in as you visit, so sweep the state systematically (coast, city, swamps, keys and countryside) and check the map for dark patches [2]. It pairs naturally with the WAiNK and vehicle-discovery counts [2]. Missable: no [1].
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

sources.detail: official list — confirms this trophy's name, description and grade
sources.name: Exophase

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: What to do: rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang in Leonida [1][4][6]. Where and how: each gang runs its own illegal operations — find one per gang, hit it and get clear [2]. The trophy needs one operation from every gang, not several from the same one, so track which gangs you have done [2]. Missable: no [1].
trophies.name: Pest Control

sources.detail: official list — confirms this trophy's name, description and grade
sources.name: Exophase

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: What to do: enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach [2]. Where and how: go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar and order an Apple Martini, then drink it standing next to the bar [2]. Missable: no evidence it can be missed [2].
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: What to do: smash your way out of a vehicle showroom, in classic GTA style — through the glass, in a car [2]. Where and how: steal the blue Banshee from the showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight out through the front window [2]. You can only take it after getting the Key Cloner in Chapter 3, in the mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs [2]. The trophy pops a moment after you drive clear of the showroom [2]. Missable: no evidence it can be missed [2].
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: What to do: follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — bowl a game there [2][4][6]. Where and how: find the Kolt & Associates alley, start a game and bowl through it; this is one of the activity types for Master of None, and the trophy pops from the bowling visit itself [3]. Missable: no [2].
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: What to do: reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time [2][3]. Where and how: work out at a fitness club with your partner along — training one trains the other too — and check each character's strength in the pause menu [2][3]. You can only switch between the two after Chapter 2, once both are playable [2]. Missable: no evidence it can be missed [2].
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: What to do: make choices that affect your Criminal Profile — GTABase reports a count of 500 profile-affecting actions [1][3][5]. Where and how: play the game making choices (missions, side activities, crimes and lawful turns alike); each choice that moves the profile counts, and the trophy pops when the count is reached [1]. It is a slow background tally, not a single decision [1]. Missable: no [1].
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: What to do: succeed on a second try at something that failed the first time [2]. Where and how: the exact trigger is not yet confirmed — PowerPyx believes it is related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue, possibly robbing it again later in a specific way [2][3]. Play normally and retry anything you fail; do not force it [3]. Missable: no evidence it can be missed [2].
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

sources.detail: currently unknown; believed Payday Loans store
sources.name: PowerPyx

trophies.guide: What to do: complete the UFO easter egg on the road north-west of the Starlet Motel [2]. Where and how: go there alone, at night after 2AM, and look for a blinking car at the roadside [2]. If the car is there, follow the path into the woods toward the bright light, approach the UFO, and talk to the woman it drops off — she sends you back to her car at the roadside [2]. If the car is not there, drive away and come back another night; the spawn is slightly random [2]. Missable: no evidence it can be missed [2].
trophies.hint: UFO easter egg · Starlet Motel, after 2AM
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

sources.detail: UFO easter egg, Starlet Motel, after 2AM
sources.name: PowerPyx

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: What to do: knock 10 pedestrians over from a bike, kicking with square, within 60 seconds [2]. Where and how: ride any bike through a crowded spot — Vice City or Ocean Beach work well — and kick pedestrians as you pass [2]. The 10 kicks must land inside a single 60-second window [2]. Missable: no [2].
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: What to do: earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts [1][4][6]. Where and how: Marked Bills come from robberies and heists — take them to your contacts to launder them into clean cash, and the tally builds toward $250,000 [2]. It is a long grind, so launder after every big score instead of letting bills pile up [2]. Missable: no [1].
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

sources.detail: official list — confirms this trophy's name, description and grade
sources.name: Exophase

trophies.guide: What to do: spend $100,000 across all shops [1][4][6]. Where and how: buy weapons, clothes, vehicles, food and upgrades anywhere in Leonida — every shop purchase counts toward the same $100,000 total [2]. Spending that supports other goals (garages, gear for the shooting range) counts double [2]. Missable: no [1].
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

sources.detail: official list — confirms this trophy's name, description and grade
sources.name: Exophase

trophies.guide: What to do: purchase every garage property in Leonida [1][4][6]. Where and how: garages are bought through the property menu when you have the cash — buy them as funds allow, since garages also store the vehicles you need for discovery and registration trophies [2]. Missable: no [1].
trophies.name: Little Boxes

sources.detail: official list — confirms this trophy's name, description and grade
sources.name: Exophase

trophies.guide: What to do: register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app [1][4][6]. Where and how: open the Scooter Bros app on the in-game phone and register vehicles you own or find — each new registration adds to the count of 10 [2]. Register as you discover new vehicles so the two tallies grow together [2]. Missable: no [1].
trophies.name: On the Spot

sources.detail: official list — confirms this trophy's name, description and grade
